findingClass: a field_sources row written by a source the manifest policy does not rank for that field/IPO-type
whatItAsks: the last 24h of field_sources writes were made by a source in the manifest's ranked set for that field and IPO type (ADMIN exempt)
alarmsWhen: any non-zero, sampled over the last 24h of field_sources.updated_at
scope: phase-1 IPOs, MAINBOARD + SME, prod + staging slots
consumerReason: a write from an unranked source is a per-cycle write-path fact, resolved to the field_sources row that produced it
